name: Su-27 Flanker: Squadron Commander's Edition
summary: Su-27 Flanker: Squadron Commander's Edition is a combat flight simulator that puts players in control of the Soviet-designed Sukhoi Su-27 fighter jet. This comprehensive package combines the base game with its mission pack expansion, while adding technical improvements including enhanced AI behavior, a strategic AWACS view, and a random mission generator. Players can create their own scenarios through an upgraded mission editor or engage in pre-made combat situations that showcase the aircraft's capabilities.
